# Generated by `articula generate`; rewritten on every generate.
# A Paperboat station as a project of its own: it uses the engine, the engine doesn't know it.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(paperboat_rig LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# The engine: the sources of a Paperboat checkout (-DPAPERBOAT_ENGINE_DIR=…, or the checkout this
# sits in), else an installed SDK (find_package(Paperboat), e.g. -DPaperboat_DIR=…).
if(NOT PAPERBOAT_ENGINE_DIR AND NOT Paperboat_DIR)
  foreach(dir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../engine" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../engine"
              "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../paperboat/engine" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../paperboat/engine")
    if(EXISTS "${dir}/CMakeLists.txt")
      set(PAPERBOAT_ENGINE_DIR "${dir}")
      break()
    endif()
  endforeach()
endif()
if(PAPERBOAT_ENGINE_DIR)
  set(PAPERBOAT_ENGINE_DIR "${PAPERBOAT_ENGINE_DIR}" CACHE PATH "Paperboat engine sources")
  add_subdirectory(${PAPERBOAT_ENGINE_DIR} paperboat EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
else()
  find_package(Paperboat 0.1 CONFIG REQUIRED)
endif()
# The program lands in build/ under every generator (station.toml's run), also multi-config ones.
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELEASE "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}")
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_DEBUG "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}")

add_executable(paperboat-rig main.cpp domain/rig.cpp)
target_link_libraries(paperboat-rig PRIVATE paperboat::core paperboat::warnings)
target_compile_definitions(paperboat-rig PRIVATE
  PAPERBOAT_DESCRIPTOR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/descriptor.toml")

# Added by hand for the study (generate doesn't write toolkits yet): the installed control and
# optimization toolkits, from the engine's sources or the SDK (paperboat toolkit install control).
foreach(tk optimization control)
  if(TARGET paperboat::toolkit_${tk})
    string(TOUPPER ${tk} TK)
    target_link_libraries(paperboat-rig PRIVATE paperboat::toolkit_${tk})
    target_compile_definitions(paperboat-rig PRIVATE PAPERBOAT_HAS_${TK}=1)
  else()
    message(WARNING "furuta-rig: the ${tk} toolkit isn't installed (paperboat toolkit install control)")
  endif()
endforeach()

# The FMU, unpacked next to the build; the adapter loads its binary at run time.
set(fmu_dir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/fmu/Rig")
file(ARCHIVE_EXTRACT INPUT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/fmu/Rig.fmu" DESTINATION "${fmu_dir}")
if(APPLE)
  set(fmu_platform darwin64)
  set(fmu_suffix .dylib)
elseif(WIN32)
  set(fmu_platform win64)
  set(fmu_suffix .dll)
else()
  set(fmu_platform linux64)
  set(fmu_suffix .so)
endif()
target_compile_definitions(paperboat-rig PRIVATE PAPERBOAT_FMU_DIR="${fmu_dir}"
  PAPERBOAT_FMU_PLATFORM="${fmu_platform}" PAPERBOAT_FMU_SUFFIX="${fmu_suffix}")
target_link_libraries(paperboat-rig PRIVATE ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
